findings.title: Shell command built from user input
findings.description: req.query.name is interpolated into a string run through child_process.exec (a shell), so shell metacharacters in `name` execute arbitrary commands. Use execFile('convert', [path, '-resize', '200x200', out]) with a validated/basename'd filename.
findings.suggestion: Use execFile with an argument array and path.basename(name) after validating against an allow-list pattern.
